title: Higher-image invertibility from the derived triangle transition
statement: For arbitrary schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a commutative coefficient ring Λ, and étale Λ-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], use the canonical inverse images and composition comparisons [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] and the canonical degree-q higher-image triangle transitions [def-sbc-module-higher-image-transitions]. Let a:Y′→Y, h:Y→X, h′:Y′→X satisfy a ≫ h=h′ and let C be a sheaf on Y. If lowerStarPlusTransition along this triangle at C placed in degree zero is invertible, then higherDirectImageTransition along the triangle at C is invertible in every integer degree q. For any morphism f:C→C′ of étale Λ-module sheaves on Y, also provide the canonical coefficient-morphism map R^q h_*(f), constructed by applying the degree-zero single-complex functor, Rh_* and degree-q homology to f; its explicit endpoint objects are higherDirectImage. For a scheme T, an arrow e:Y→T and an étale Λ-module sheaf F on T, the target-functor comparison identifies baseChangeTargetFunctor(e,h,q)(F) with R^q h_*(e*F), using the target functor of [def-sbc-canonical-base-change-stalk-transitions]. For a coefficient isomorphism C≅C′ on Y, its higher-image isomorphism is the image under the single-complex, Rh_* and homology functors with these explicit object types. The hom of the mapped coefficient isomorphism is the coefficient-morphism map, and higherDirectImageOverMap is its triangle transition followed by that coefficient-morphism map of the inverse composition comparison.

proof.text: The exact pullback-single comparison is an isomorphism. Map it by the target derived direct image, compose with the assumed invertible triangle transition, and map by degree-q homology. Functors and composition preserve isomorphisms. The proof builds kernel-checked congruence certificates between this abstract functor expression and the public higherDirectImageTransition definition, avoiding expensive reduction of derived-category projections. The additional mapping API constructs the nested functor maps directly after unfolding the named higher-image object. Its equations and the OverMap equation are reflexive computations; no coefficient object or comparison changes.

Provide baseChangeTargetFunctorHigherImageIso directly by mapping the exact pullback-single isomorphism with Rh_* and degree-q homology. This equals the original baseChangeTargetFunctorIso component: every associator component in that construction is an identity. Define higherDirectImageMap and higherDirectImageMapIso as the direct nested single-functor, Rh_* and homology maps, with their same explicit endpoint objects. Removing tactic-generated object conversions reduces repeated kernel checking; no sheaf, arrow or comparison changes. The hom and OverMap formulas remain reflexive computations.
